name: Malachite: Temple of the Sun
description:
Embark on a journey through the depths of a lost ancient jungle temple in Malachite: Temple of the Sun.

With over 50+ levels, each stage offers both Adventure and Endless mode for all players! Match colorful balls, unleash ball power-ups, and experience the excitement of building your own temple as you progress.

Rediscover the classic charm of marble matching games with a modern twist, and get ready for hours of addictive gameplay.

With vibrant visuals and intuitive controls, Malachite: Temple of the Sun is the ultimate nostalgic adventure for players of all ages.

description_raw:
Feature ListFast, colorful ball-shooting fun across 45 levels. Make matches and clear combinations of three or more from ball chains in order to progress. Complete chapters to collect pieces for the grand temple. Catch a wide array of magical powerups. Play your way—enjoy a calming experience with the Zen difficulty, or turn up the heat on Challenging!  See how long you can last with Endless Mode! Clear 5 bonus chapters to add structures to your temple! 25 bonus levels in 5 extra chapters.
